title: discovery._iter_source_files skips EVERY file when the project itself lives under a dir named build/vendor/target/dist (IGNORE_DIRS checked against absolute path parts)
detail: Spotted 2026-10-25 while scoping python-from-import-edges: prusik/discovery.py _iter_source_files tests `any(part in IGNORE_DIRS for part in p.parts)` on the ABSOLUTE path, so a project at e.g. ~/work/build/myapp or /opt/vendor/svc yields zero source files — empty inventory, empty dep-graph, map-freshness and blast radius silently blind. Fix: test p.relative_to(root).parts; moat-test with a project rooted under a dir named build/.
